en: Black‑and‑white image of a large statue of a standing man in 18th‑century dress atop a tall pedestal in a landscaped park. At the base of the monument is a sculpted eagle with outstretched wings surrounded by wreaths or plants. Several people in late‑19th/early‑20th‑century clothing (men in long overcoats and bowler or top hats, women in long skirts and large hats) stand and stroll around the monument on a gravel path, with dense trees in the background. The stone pedestal bears an inscription but it is not legible in this reproduction.
